lines.text: The person begins with a small, compact movement near the centre of the body, then rapidly extends through the spine, shoulders, arms, and legs as if a sudden force has spread outward.
The person reacts as though the ground is tilting beneath them, bending the knees, leaning the torso in different directions, and taking quick corrective steps to avoid falling.
The person travels across the floor in broad sideways movements, pushing strongly from one leg to the other and allowing the arms and torso to sweep in the direction of travel.
The person repeatedly springs from the floor, extending the legs and reaching upward with the arms, each time falling back down before the hands can reach the desired place.

The person repeatedly drops and rebounds with increasing force, then makes one powerful vertical jump, extending the legs and reaching both arms upward. The person lands, allows the body to descend to the floor, and finishes lying flat and motionless.
